subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should a fix PR wait for a redacted raw OpenWebUI image-upload request or live repro before changing the Gateway/tool path?
rationale: Current main already handles standard `image_url` content, so without the actual OpenWebUI payload a repair worker could patch the wrong layer or add duplicate parser behavior.

options.title: Require request capture first
options.body: Keep this as maintainer/live-repro work until a redacted OpenWebUI request body and Gateway trace show where the payload becomes empty.

options.title: Sponsor QA reproduction now
options.body: Have a maintainer extend the OpenWebUI Docker probe to send an image upload and use that result as the fix driver.

options.title: Queue a speculative parser fix
options.body: Allow a narrow repair attempt, accepting the risk that it may not match OpenWebUI's actual payload shape.

recommendation.title: Require request capture first
recommendation.body: Keep this as maintainer/live-repro work until a redacted OpenWebUI request body and Gateway trace show where the payload becomes empty.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant standard chat-completions image forwarding path was introduced in this area by vincentkoc, and the remaining question is whether to change that parser without the raw OpenWebUI payload.
